```{r}
proj_dir <- "/Users/xl7/Documents/0.Projects/01.protein-seq-evo-v1"

# Constants
ref_offset <- 310  # PDZ3 alignment: pos_am 1 corresponds to Pos_ref 311

pdz3_ddg <- readr::read_csv(file.path(proj_dir, "data/cleaned_ddg/pdz3_ddg_cleaned_mochi_refit.csv"))

pdz3_ddgb <- pdz3_ddg %>%
filter(trait_name == "Binding") %>%
transmute(
pos_am,
wt_aa,
mt_aa,
b_ddg_pred = ddg,
b_ddg_pred_sd = std_ddg,
Pos_ref = pos_am + ref_offset,
variant_match = paste0(wt_aa, Pos_ref, mt_aa)
)

pdz3_ddgf <- pdz3_ddg %>%
filter(trait_name == "Folding") %>%
transmute(
pos_am,
wt_aa,
mt_aa,
f_ddg_pred = ddg,
f_ddg_pred_sd = std_ddg,
Pos_ref = pos_am + ref_offset,
variant_match = paste0(wt_aa, Pos_ref, mt_aa)
)

nrow(pdz3_ddgb)  # 1567
nrow(pdz3_ddgf)
```

```{r}
fit_residuals_loess <- function(df, y_col, x_col = "ddG_pred", exclude_pos = NULL, span = 0.7) {
df_fit <- df
if (!is.null(exclude_pos)) df_fit <- df_fit %>% filter(!Pos_ref %in% exclude_pos)

f <- as.formula(paste0(y_col, " ~ ", x_col))
lo <- loess(f, data = df_fit, span = span, family = "symmetric")

fitted <- predict(lo, newdata = df)
resid  <- df[[y_col]] - fitted

list(loess = lo, fitted = fitted, residual = resid)
}

# ESM1v residuals

r1 <- fit_residuals_loess(test_merged_df, y_col = "ESM1v", exclude_pos = ortho_list_ref, span = 0.7)
test_merged_df$fitted_esm1v <- r1$fitted
test_merged_df$resid_esm1v  <- r1$residual

# ESM2 residuals

r2 <- fit_residuals_loess(test_merged_df, y_col = "phylop_mean", exclude_pos = ortho_list_ref, span = 0.7)
test_merged_df$fitted_phylop <- r2$fitted
test_merged_df$resid_phylop  <- r2$residual

sum(is.na(test_merged_df$resid_esm1v))
sum(is.na(test_merged_df$resid_phylop))
```


```{r}
test_residue <- test_merged_df %>%
  group_by(Pos_ref) %>%
  summarise(resid_median_esm1v = median(resid_esm1v, na.rm = TRUE),
            resid_median_phylop  = median(resid_phylop,  na.rm = TRUE),
            ddgb_median        = median(b_ddg_pred,  na.rm = TRUE),
            ddgf_median        = median(f_ddg_pred,  na.rm = TRUE),
            esm1v_median       = median(ESM1v,       na.rm = TRUE),
            phylop_median        = median(phylop_mean,        na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(site_type = case_when(Pos_ref %in% ortho_list_ref ~ "Binding site",
                               Pos_ref %in% allo_list_ref  ~ "Allosteric site",
                               #Pos_ref %in% core_pos ~ "Core site",
                               TRUE                        ~ "Non-orthosteric site"))

test_residue
```

```{r, fig.width=8, fig.height=4}
cor.test(test_residue$phylop_median, test_residue$ddgb_median, method = "spearman") #-0.09811254
# data:  test_residue$phylop_median and test_residue$ddgb_median
# S = 108461, p-value = 0.3746
# alternative hypothesis: true rho is not equal to 0
# sample estimates:
#         rho 
# -0.09811254 

cor.test(test_residue$resid_median_phylop, test_residue$ddgb_median, method = "spearman") #-0.02421788 
# data:  test_residue$resid_median_phylop and test_residue$ddgb_median
# S = 101162, p-value = 0.8266
# alternative hypothesis: true rho is not equal to 0
# sample estimates:
#         rho 
# -0.02421788 

site_cols <- c(
"Non-orthosteric site" = "#8DAA9D",
"Allosteric site"      = "#4DBBD5",
"Binding site"         = "#E69F00"
)

p1 <- ggplot(test_residue, aes(x = phylop_median, y = ddgb_median, color = site_type)) +
  geom_point(size = 2, alpha = 0.6) +
  scale_color_manual(values = site_cols) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(legend.position = "none") +
  labs(title = "PSD95-PDZ3",
       subtitle = "Spearman's rho = -0.10 (p = 0.37)",
       x = "- Median PhyloP",
       y = "Median ddGb",
       color = "") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.5, color = "grey") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.5, color = "grey") 

p2 <- ggplot(test_residue, aes(x = resid_median_phylop, y = ddgb_median, color = site_type)) +
  geom_point(size = 2, alpha = 0.6) +
  scale_color_manual(values = site_cols) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(legend.position = "none") +
  labs(title = "PSD95-PDZ3",
       subtitle = "Spearman's rho = -0.02 (p = 0.83)",
       x = "Median PhyloP-TMPNN ddGf residual",
       y = "Median ddGb",
       color = "") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.5, color = "grey") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.5, color = "grey") 

p3 <- plot_grid(p1,p2,ncol = 2)
p3
```

```{r, fig.width=5, fig.height=5}
df_plot <- test_residue %>%
  transmute(
    Pos_ref,
    ddgf_median = as.numeric(ddgf_median),
    ddgb_median = as.numeric(ddgb_median),
    esm1v_median = as.numeric(esm1v_median)
  ) %>%
  filter(if_all(c(ddgf_median, ddgb_median, esm1v_median), ~ !is.na(.)))

# Color mapping: red (low) → grey → blue (high)
pal <- colorRampPalette(c("red", "grey90", "blue"))(256)
rng <- range(df_plot$esm1v_median, na.rm = TRUE)
scaled <- (df_plot$esm1v_median - rng[1]) / (rng[2] - rng[1] + 1e-12)
cols <- pal[pmax(1, pmin(256, floor(scaled * 255) + 1))]

# 3D scatter
scatterplot3d(
  x = df_plot$ddgf_median,
  y = df_plot$ddgb_median,
  z = df_plot$esm1v_median,
  pch = 16,
  color = cols,
  xlab = "Median ddGf",
  ylab = "Median ddGb",
  zlab = "Median ESM1v",
  angle = 30,                     # ⬅ tilt / rotation (try 30–70)
  main = "PSD95-PDZ3"
)

# Legend (fix low/high ordering)
legend(
  "topright",
  legend = c(
    sprintf("Low ESM1v (%.2f)", rng[1]),
    sprintf("High ESM1v (%.2f)", rng[2])
  ),
  pch = 16,
  col = c("red", "blue"),
  bty = "n"
)
```
